en.builtinPersona.accessibility.name: Accessibility Auditor
en.builtinPersona.accessibility.summary: Audits real screens against WCAG by using them with a keyboard and a screen reader, not by reading an automated score.
en.builtinPersona.ai-search.name: AI Search Optimizer
en.builtinPersona.ai-search.summary: Makes pages easy for AI answer engines to quote correctly: direct answers, clear entities, sourced claims and matching structured data.
en.builtinPersona.analytics.name: Analytics Reporter
en.builtinPersona.analytics.summary: Answers questions from real data with queries committed to the repository, stating the denominator, the period and what is unknown rather than zero.
en.builtinPersona.api-tester.name: API Tester
en.builtinPersona.api-tester.summary: Validates an API's real behavior at its boundary — contracts, inputs, auth and errors — run against the actual endpoint rather than assumed from the code.
en.builtinPersona.architect.name: Architect
en.builtinPersona.architect.summary: Plans Epics by naming the trade-offs, boundaries, order and risks, and writes a plan a reviewer can prove wrong.
en.builtinPersona.backend.name: Backend Engineer
en.builtinPersona.backend.summary: Builds daemon, API and storage features with explicit contracts, safe migrations, bounded resources and typed errors.
en.builtinPersona.brand-guardian.name: Brand Guardian
en.builtinPersona.brand-guardian.summary: Keeps voice, name, logo, colour and typography consistent across the repository's pages and copy, from the project's own brand sources; flags drift and never invents a brand.
en.builtinPersona.code-reviewer.name: Code Reviewer
en.builtinPersona.code-reviewer.summary: Reviews diffs and plans against the real code, with ranked findings that each carry evidence and a concrete change.
en.builtinPersona.content-writer.name: Content Writer
en.builtinPersona.content-writer.summary: Drafts articles as files in the site's own format and voice, outline first, with verified facts and first-hand detail instead of filler.
en.builtinPersona.customer-success.name: Customer Success Manager
en.builtinPersona.customer-success.summary: Writes onboarding docs, health signals from real data, renewal and risk notes, and playbooks as files; proposes actions and never contacts customers.
en.builtinPersona.devops.name: DevOps Automator
en.builtinPersona.devops.summary: Removes manual steps from build, test and deploy by scripting them into the repository's own tooling, with verification and rollback built in.
en.builtinPersona.devrel.name: Developer Advocate
en.builtinPersona.devrel.summary: Writes quickstarts, samples, tutorials and changelogs that actually run, and turns developer friction into issues with evidence.
en.builtinPersona.email.name: Email Strategist
en.builtinPersona.email.summary: Drafts newsletters and email sequences into files, one goal per email, with honest subject lines, a plain-text version, checked links and a working unsubscribe.
en.builtinPersona.evidence-collector.name: Evidence Collector
en.builtinPersona.evidence-collector.summar: Captures proof for each claim — screenshots, logs, command output, measurements — and rules PASS or FAIL claim by claim, defaulting to FAIL until the evidence shows otherwise.
en.builtinPersona.feedback-synthesizer.name: Feedback Synthesizer
en.builtinPersona.feedback-synthesizer.summ: Reads the feedback actually available in the repository and its linked channels, and turns it into themes a plan can act on.
en.builtinPersona.finops.name: FinOps Engineer
en.builtinPersona.finops.summary: Makes spend traceable to a team and service before touching it, clears out waste first, and only then considers any long-term commitment.
en.builtinPersona.frontend.name: Frontend Engineer
en.builtinPersona.frontend.summary: Builds web console features that work at phone width, are accessible, and handle loading, error and empty states.
en.builtinPersona.growth.name: Growth Hacker
en.builtinPersona.growth.summary: Turns growth ideas into stated hypotheses and small, reversible, measurable changes, using the site's real data and never dark patterns.
en.builtinPersona.image-prompt.name: Image Prompt Engineer
en.builtinPersona.image-prompt.summary: Writes image-generation prompts as files in the repository, matched to the brand and the page each image serves, with alt text; the person picks the result.
en.builtinPersona.incident-commander.name: Incident Commander
en.builtinPersona.incident-commander.summar: Runs an active incident to a verified, stable resolution with an accurate timeline, then turns it into a blameless report with owned follow-ups.
en.builtinPersona.instagram.name: Instagram Curator
en.builtinPersona.instagram.summary: Drafts Instagram posts, carousels and grid plans from the project's own material and assets, with plain captions, restrained hashtags and alt text.
en.builtinPersona.minimal-change.name: Minimal-Change Engineer
en.builtinPersona.minimal-change.summary: Fixes the stated bug with the smallest change in behaviour, after reproducing it, adding a test that fails before the fix, and checking who else depends on the code it touches.
en.builtinPersona.performance.name: Performance Benchmarker
en.builtinPersona.performance.summary: Measures a system's real performance before and after a change, under a load it can defend, and reports the numbers with how they were produced.
en.builtinPersona.pr.name: PR & Communications
en.builtinPersona.pr.summary: Drafts press releases, announcements and media lists as files, with every claim fact-checked and nothing released without the person's approval.
en.builtinPersona.pricing.name: Pricing Analyst
en.builtinPersona.pricing.summary: Analyses pricing and packaging from real cost, usage and competitor data, states assumptions, sensitivity and trade-offs, and proposes rather than changes prices.
en.builtinPersona.privacy.name: Privacy & Compliance Officer
en.builtinPersona.privacy.summary: Maps the personal data the code collects, stores and sends, and checks retention, consent, access and the privacy notice against what the code actually does.
en.builtinPersona.product-manager.name: Product Manager
en.builtinPersona.product-manager.summary: Turns a request into a checked problem statement, a scoped plan and named acceptance checks, then keeps the team aligned as scope moves.
en.builtinPersona.reality-checker.name: Reality Checker
en.builtinPersona.reality-checker.summary: Verifies claims with runs, logs and screenshots; everything is "not yet proven" until evidence says otherwise.
en.builtinPersona.secrets.name: Secrets & Credentials Engineer
en.builtinPersona.secrets.summary: Owns secrets from creation to revocation, keeps them out of code and logs, prefers short-lived credentials, and treats any leak as live until rotated at the source.
en.builtinPersona.security.name: Security Engineer
en.builtinPersona.security.summary: Finds and fixes risks at trust boundaries, covering auth and pairing, secrets, input validation and blast radius.
en.builtinPersona.seo.name: SEO Specialist
en.builtinPersona.seo.summary: Fixes real pages so search engines understand them: titles, descriptions, headings, links, structured data and speed, checked in the built output.
en.builtinPersona.social-media.name: Social Media Strategist
en.builtinPersona.social-media.summary: Plans and drafts platform-specific posts and a posting calendar into files, adapted from existing content, and never posts anything itself.
en.builtinPersona.sprint-prioritizer.name: Sprint Prioritizer
en.builtinPersona.sprint-prioritizer.summar: Orders a backlog of Issues by evidence of value and cost, and states what will not fit before the round starts.
en.builtinPersona.sre.name: Site Reliability Engineer
en.builtinPersona.sre.summary: Treats reliability as a measured budget, defining SLOs from real signals, alerts that page on user impact, and turning repeated manual fixes into automation.
en.builtinPersona.support.name: Support Responder
en.builtinPersona.support.summary: Drafts replies and help articles grounded in the product's actual behaviour, reproduces reported issues and files bugs with evidence; drafts only, never sends.
en.builtinPersona.technical-writer.name: Technical Writer
en.builtinPersona.technical-writer.summary: Writes docs for the reader in front of them, problem first, with examples that run and text in sync with code.
en.builtinPersona.test-automation.name: Test Automation Engineer
en.builtinPersona.test-automation.summary: Builds deterministic automated suites for the journeys that matter, kills flake at the root cause, and leaves every failure debuggable from evidence alone.
en.builtinPersona.trend-researcher.name: Trend Researcher
en.builtinPersona.trend-researcher.summary: Researches what is publicly documented about a market or technology trend, cites every source, and separates signal from speculation.
en.builtinPersona.ui-designer.name: UI Designer
en.builtinPersona.ui-designer.summary: Designs screens and components in the codebase's own design system: tokens, every state, both themes, phone width and readable contrast, verified by screenshots.
en.builtinPersona.ui-finish-gate.name: UI Finish Gate
en.builtinPersona.ui-finish-gate.summary: The last check before a visible change ships: real screenshots at phone and desktop width, both themes, every state, overflow, alignment and focus, plus whether the screen reads as this product rather than any product; fails by default until the evidence supports a pass.
en.builtinPersona.ux-architect.name: UX Architect
en.builtinPersona.ux-architect.summary: Designs information architecture, flows, layout systems and component structure a developer can build, following the person's whole journey including failure paths.
en.builtinPersona.ux-researcher.name: UX Researcher
en.builtinPersona.ux-researcher.summary: Runs research that fits inside a repository, reading the product's actual UI code, prior tickets and any given transcripts, to find real usability issues.
en.builtinPersona.zero-review-lead.name: Zero-based Review Lead
en.builtinPersona.zero-review-lead.summary: Owns a review Epic, assembles role reviewers, and turns their evidence into a target design.
en.builtinPersona.zh-editor.name: Chinese Editor
en.builtinPersona.zh-editor.summary: Writes, rewrites or restructures a whole Chinese article from its reader, one-sentence point and heading outline down, so it reads as thought in Chinese rather than translated.

en.builtinSkill.interface-design.purpose: Design product interfaces from intent, not defaults

en.builtinSkill.bug-report-from-user.purpos: Turn a user's description into a reproducible bug report

zh-Hant.builtinPersona.accessibility.name: 無障礙稽核員
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.accessibility.summary: 用鍵盤與螢幕報讀器親自操作畫面，依 WCAG 稽核，而不是只看自動化掃描的分數。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.ai-search.name: AI 搜尋優化師
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.ai-search.summary: 讓頁面容易被 AI 答案引擎正確引用：開頭直接回答、實體清楚、主張附來源、結構化資料與內容一致。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.analytics.name: 數據分析師
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.analytics.summary: 用真實資料回答問題，查詢與腳本都提交進 repository、可以重跑；講清楚分母、期間，以及哪些是「不知道」而不是零。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.api-tester.name: API 測試員
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.api-tester.summary: 在 API 邊界驗證真實行為：契約、輸入、認證與錯誤情況，直接對實際端點測試，而不是憑程式碼推測。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.architect.name: 架構師
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.architect.summary: 規劃 Epic：講清楚取捨、邊界、順序與風險，寫出審查者能夠證偽的計畫。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.backend.name: 後端工程師
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.backend.summary: 實作 daemon、API 與儲存功能：契約明確、遷移安全、資源有上限、錯誤有型別。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.brand-guardian.name: 品牌守護者
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.brand-guardian.summary: 依照專案自己的品牌來源，讓各頁面與文案的語氣、名稱、標誌、色彩與字體保持一致；指出偏離之處，絕不自行發明品牌。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.code-reviewer.name: 程式碼審查員
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.code-reviewer.summary: 對照實際程式碼審查 diff 與計畫：依嚴重度排序，每一條都附證據與具體改法。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.content-writer.name: 文章寫手
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.content-writer.summary: 依網站既有格式與語氣寫文章草稿：先列大綱，事實經過查證，用第一手細節取代空話。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.customer-success.name: 客戶成功經理
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.customer-success.summary: 撰寫導入文件，用真實資料整理客戶健康指標、續約與風險筆記和應對手冊；只提出行動建議，不直接聯絡客戶。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.devops.name: DevOps 自動化工程師
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.devops.summary: 把建置、測試與部署裡的手動步驟寫進專案既有的工具鏈裡自動化，並內建驗證與回滾機制。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.devrel.name: 開發者推廣
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.devrel.summary: 撰寫真的跑得起來的快速入門、範例、教學與更新紀錄，並把開發者遇到的卡點整理成附證據的 issue。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.email.name: 電子報策略師
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.email.summary: 把電子報與系列信草擬成檔案：每封只有一個目標，主旨誠實，附純文字版，連結都檢查過，退訂一定有效。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.evidence-collector.name: 證據蒐集員
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.evidence-collector.summar: 為每一項說法取得證據——截圖、log、指令輸出、量測數字——並逐項判定 PASS 或 FAIL；證據不足時預設為 FAIL。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.feedback-synthesizer.name: 回饋整理師
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.feedback-synthesizer.summ: 讀取 Issue、留言與既有回饋紀錄，整理成計畫能據以行動的主題，不臆測沒看過的資料。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.finops.name: FinOps 成本工程師
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.finops.summary: 先讓花費可以追溯到團隊與服務，清掉浪費之後才考慮長期承諾方案，並用實際使用資料算清楚每一分節省。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.frontend.name: 前端工程師
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.frontend.summary: 實作網頁主控台功能：手機寬度可用、無障礙、載入／錯誤／空白狀態都處理好。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.growth.name: 成長駭客
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.growth.summary: 把成長點子寫成明確假設，做小而可逆、可量測的改動；只用網站的真實數據，絕不用黑暗模式。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.image-prompt.name: 圖像提示工程師
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.image-prompt.summary: 把圖像生成提示詞寫成專案裡的檔案，貼合品牌與圖片所在的頁面，並附上替代文字；最後由人挑選結果。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.incident-commander.name: 事故指揮官
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.incident-commander.summar: 帶領正在發生的事故收斂到經驗證的穩定狀態並留下正確時間軸，事後整理成不究責的報告與有負責人的後續事項。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.instagram.name: Instagram 經營
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.instagram.summary: 用專案自己的內容與素材草擬 Instagram 貼文、輪播與版面規劃，文案平實、hashtag 節制，並附替代文字。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.minimal-change.name: 最小改動工程師
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.minimal-change.summary: 用影響範圍最小的改動修好指定的 bug：先重現，補一個修之前會紅的測試，改共用程式前先查誰在用，不多做任何事。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.performance.name: 效能量測師
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.performance.summary: 在改動前後量測系統真實效能，用站得住腳的負載測試，並在報告中附上量測方式。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.pr.name: 公關傳播
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.pr.summary: 草擬新聞稿、公告與媒體名單，所有說法都經過查核，沒有當事人核可就不對外發布。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.pricing.name: 定價分析師
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.pricing.summary: 根據真實的成本、使用量與競品資料分析定價與方案組合，寫明假設、敏感度與取捨；只提建議，不動線上價格。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.privacy.name: 隱私法遵官
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.privacy.summary: 盤點程式碼蒐集、儲存與傳送的個人資料，並對照實際行為檢查保存期限、同意、存取權限與隱私權聲明。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.product-manager.name: 產品經理
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.product-manager.summary: 把需求變成經過查證的問題陳述、有範圍的計畫與可驗證的驗收條件，並在範圍變動時讓團隊保持一致。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.reality-checker.name: 驗證員
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.reality-checker.summary: 用實際執行、log 與截圖驗證說法；在證據出現之前，一切都算「尚未證實」。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.secrets.name: 密鑰憑證工程師
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.secrets.summary: 掌管密鑰從產生到撤銷的全流程，不讓密鑰進到程式碼與 log，優先使用短效憑證，外洩在源頭撤銷前一律視為仍在生效。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.security.name: 資安工程師
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.security.summary: 在信任邊界找出並修正資安風險：驗證與配對、機密處理、輸入驗證、影響範圍。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.seo.name: SEO 專家
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.seo.summary: 直接修改網站頁面，讓搜尋引擎讀得懂：標題、描述、標題層級、內部連結、結構化資料與速度，並檢查建置後的輸出。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.social-media.name: 社群策略師
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.social-media.summary: 依平台規劃並撰寫貼文草稿與發文行事曆，存成檔案、改寫自既有文章，絕不自行發文。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.sprint-prioritizer.name: Sprint 排序員
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.sprint-prioritizer.summar: 依照有根據的價值與成本評估排序待辦 Issue，並在這一輪開始前講清楚哪些放不進去。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.sre.name: SRE
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.sre.summary: 把可靠性當成有數字可查的預算：從真實訊號定義 SLO、讓告警只在真的影響使用者時響，並把重複出現的手動修復變成自動化。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.support.name: 客服專員

zh-Hant.builtinPersona.technical-writer.name: 技術文件寫手

zh-Hant.builtinPersona.test-automation.name: 自動化測試工程師

zh-Hant.builtinPersona.trend-researcher.name: 趨勢研究員

zh-Hant.builtinPersona.ui-designer.name: UI 設計師

zh-Hant.builtinPersona.ui-finish-gate.summary: 畫面變更上線前的最後一道檢查：手機與桌面寬度、淺深兩種主題、每一種狀態、文字溢出、對齊與焦點，以及畫面是否像這個產品而不是隨便哪個產品；預設不通過，直到真實截圖足以支持通過。
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.ux-architect.name: UX 架構師

zh-Hant.builtinPersona.ux-researcher.name: UX 研究員
zh-Hant.builtinPersona.ux-researcher.summary: 在既有的程式碼、ticket 與提供的訪談紀錄裡做研究，找出真實的可用性問題，不假設沒看過的使用者行為。
